}

employee_department_df = pd.DataFrame(employee_department_data)

# Process the data to generate the report
attendance_df['Arrival'] = pd.to_datetime(attendance_df['Arrival'], format='%H:%M')
attendance_df['Departure'] = pd.to_datetime(attendance_df['Departure'], format='%H:%M')

# Calculate work length, on-time departure, and late arrival
attendance_df['Work Length'] = (attendance_df['Departure'] - attendance_df['Arrival']).dt.total_seconds() / 3600
attendance_df['On-time Departure'] = ((attendance_df['Departure'].dt.time >= pd.to_datetime('17:30').time()) & 
                                       (attendance_df['Departure'].dt.time <= pd.to_datetime('18:00').time())).astype(int)
attendance_df['Late Arrival'] = (attendance_df['Arrival'].dt.time > pd.to_datetime('09:00').time()).astype(int)

# Merge with department data
report_df = pd.merge(attendance_df, employee_department_df, on='Name')

# Aggregate the results by department
department_report = report_df.groupby('Department').agg({
    'Work Length': 'mean',
    'On-time Departure': 'mean',
    'Late Arrival': 'mean'
}).reset_index()

# Rename columns
department_report.columns = ['Department', 'Average Work Length', 'Average On-time Departure Count', 'Average Late Arrival Count']
